title: Threshold runbook docket (shift scratch)
content:
Shift: Gideon Park (06:00-14:00 UTC) — grab-and-go scratch for oncall. Handoff from Mira (notes below).

Quick summary / context:
- Overnight pages for embedding-service latency and KV-cache thrashing (INC-2047).
- Root cause likely hot-keyed prefix that bypassed prefix-cache and created very large batch sizes on a small subset of workers.
- Temporary mitigation: scaled dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-pool-3) + enforced batch-size cap using routing policy; reverted model-variant v2.3 -> v2.2 for the heavy route.

Timeline (rough):
- 02:11 UTC: first alert — 95th latency for /embed API > 3s (pager escalated to SEV3).
- 02:15 UTC: debug, saw worker p99 memory at 96% on one node.
- 02:22 UTC: applied routing override to route heavy customer to fallback-region; scale + drain problem node.
- 02:45 UTC: latency improved but intermittent errors while draining KV cache shards.
- 03:10 UTC: rolled back to v2.2 for route embed-large (immediate improvement).
- 04:00 UTC: stabilized; left autoscale policy stricter for next 3 hours.

Commands & quick ops notes (copy as needed):
- rwinfctl nodes list --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-3 --region us-west2
- rwinfctl routing set-override --route embed-large --policy failover --target-region us-east1 --reason "temp-mitigation"
- kubectl -n runtime exec -it worker-abc -- sh -c 'ps aux | grep model_worker' (used for ad-hoc inspection)
- grep -E "cache_eviction|kv_shard" /var/log/runtime/worker.log | tail -n 200

Runbook gaps noted (actionable):
1) No explicit step to cap batch size per-route in the public runbook — runbook currently suggests "consider reducing batch size" but lacks the rwinfctl command. TODO: add exact command snippet + safe rollback pattern.
2) KV-cache shard alarm thresholds are too loose; add a synthetic test that exercises hot prefixes and validates eviction within X min.
3) Add playbook step: automatic model-variant fallback when p95 latency crosses 2s for >5m. Document expected cost tradeoffs.
4) Add checklist item for draining node gracefully when memory >90% to avoid transient 5xx from cache eviction race.

Follow-ups / tickets to open or update:
- JIRA: INF-3245 — "Runbook: explicit batch-size cap + rwinfctl examples" (assign to me, target: next sprint).
- JIRA: INF-3246 — "KV-cache synthetic monitor for hot-prefix eviction" (SLO/observability).
- JIRA: INF-3247 — "Auto-fallback policy by latency thresholds (prod)" (product + runtime).
- GitHub PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/821 — draft with a helper script to cap batch sizes per route (needs review).

Things I want to capture before I forget:
- Weirdness: a small subset of requests contained an unusually long prefix (user prompt metadata) that expanded sequence lengths by ~30%; we should add a telemetry tag for tokenized-length-at-ingest.
- Customer call flagged: ACME Corp (ticket ACME-1189 contacted CS). Coordinate with Solutions Eng to share mitigation + timeline.

Handoff notes for next shift:
- Keep autoscale policy for dedicated-gpu-pool-3 in "strict" mode until 18:00 UTC today; then revert if stable for 6h.
- Watch for new spikes in embed-large route; set a temporary alert: p95 > 1.8s for 10m.
- If pages repeat with memory growth on a single node, drain and reprovision node image (possible kernel/libc/membarrier mismatch).

Loose ideas / brainstorm (not for public runbook yet):
- Consider a short-lived per-route memcache for really hot prefixes (fast eviction TTL 30s) to protect KV shards. Needs perf eval.
- Maybe add a lightweight token-length histogram emitted at ingest (sampling 0.5%) to avoid high-cardinality telemetry explosion.

Personal TODO (quick):
- [ ] Draft INF-3245 (runbook + copy/paste commands) — due before sprint planning (2027-04-15).
- [ ] Pair with Maya on synthetic monitor design (blocker: current datadog account limits).
- [ ] Attach logs & timeline to INC-2047 in Jira; include the scaling events and model rollback timestamps.

Notes to self: keep this doc rough. Will clean up and move final checklist to the runbooks repo once tickets exist.

Linked artifacts & references:
- INC-2047 (PagerDuty)
- INF-3245, INF-3246, INF-3247 (Jira)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/821
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/Runbook+Serving+Runtime (quick link)

End of shift scribble.
